initial_understanding: On /ar the heading «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» reads like a valuation service, while the description «اكتشف عقارات أربيل ومؤشرات السوق ومعروضات العقارات مع أنداز.» promises listings; she cannot tell which it is (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» — she owns nothing yet, so a promise about the value of 'your property' seems aimed at sellers, not at a first buyer (E-SITE-04).
trust_concern_observed: Zero phone numbers on every scanned page, /contact and /privacy returning '404 · Andaz', and only info@ addresses found by deep scan lower her already skeptical trust (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-17, E-SITE-03).
frustration_point: Her trigger is no way to reach a lister; project pages carry no phone and /contact is a 404, so after a patient search she gives up (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-17).
most_useful_feature: The Arabic locale exists with a translated offers-map title «عقارات للبيع والإيجار — Andaz», so browsing in her language is possible (E-SITE-20).
missing_information: Whether a ready apartment near Ankawa costs about $80,000 and what its installments total; no price or payment text in any project data (E-SITE-08). Advisor answers were not observable (E-ACC-05).
what_would_change_decision: A WhatsApp or call route on every project page plus an indicative price range and installment basis.
simulated_reaction: «الموقع يحكي عن قيمة عقاري وأنا ما عندي عقار بعد، وما لقيت رقم أتصل عليه.» (The site talks about my property's value, I have none yet, and I found no number to call.)

initial_understanding: The homepage is served in Sorani and its heading «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» tells him plainly the site is about property value, close enough to his trend question (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Status wording such as «ڕاگەیەنراو یان داهاتوو» on project pages takes effort for a slow reader who only wants a number per square metre (E-SITE-08).
trust_concern_observed: Developer names like «لۆریەنت کۆنسترەکشن» and the phrase «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» suggest someone checks the data, which a neutral investor counts as a plus (E-SITE-08).
frustration_point: His trigger is missing prices; descriptions list units, towers and floors but no price or payment basis anywhere, so he abandons the project page quickly (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-22).
most_useful_feature: Detailed pages such as Cavalli Tower (745 units, 2 towers, 47 floors, «شاهان گروپ») give a knowledgeable buyer facts to compare (E-SITE-08).
missing_information: Price trends for «شۆرش» versus «كورانی عەنكاوە»; the market page is only a placeholder «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە» (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: A dated indicative price per square metre on each project and area page.
simulated_reaction: «ژمارەی تاوەر و نهۆم هەیە، بەڵام نرخ نییە؛ من بە نرخ بڕیار دەدەم نەک بە نهۆم.» (Tower and floor counts are there but no price; I decide by price, not by floors.)

initial_understanding: The Sorani heading «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» sounds like an estimate for people who already own something; nothing in the metadata tells her where $95,000 units are listed (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'Sign in or create an account · Andaz' with the heading 'Welcome back' appears in English at the Kurdish path; she reads English but did not expect the switch (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: Three spellings of one project, «شاری ئیتاڵی 2», «شاری ئیتالی 2» and «ئیتالی ستی 2», look careless to a fluent Kurdish reader, though she stays trusting (E-SITE-10).
frustration_point: Her trigger is registering before seeing prices; what the account pages actually require was never observed, and on an unstable connection that uncertainty alone ends the visit (E-SITE-12, E-ACC-05).
most_useful_feature: none for this persona; the search and comparison tasks (T02, T04) touch areas that were not observable through metadata (E-ACC-05).
missing_information: Whether any project accepts a 20% down payment on a $95,000 unit; no payment-plan text exists in any project description or JSON-LD (E-SITE-08).
what_would_change_decision: Say on the homepage that browsing prices needs no account, and serve the account pages in Sorani.
simulated_reaction: «دەمەوێ بزانم ٪٢٠ پێشەکی قبوڵ دەکەن یان نا، نەک ئەکاونت دروست بکەم.» (I want to know whether they accept 20% down, not to create an account.)

initial_understanding: Reading slowly, she picks out «خانووبەرەکانی هەولێر» from the description and takes the site for an Erbil property catalogue rather than a place to learn about a neighbourhood (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'Create your Andaz account' — the register page switches to English at the Kurdish path, and for a low-reading Sorani reader that step becomes a wall (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: No published or modified date appears in any project metadata, so she cannot judge freshness from Australia, which is what she fears most (E-SITE-08).
frustration_point: Her trigger is listings with no 'updated' date; area pages carry only the generic site description and no date, so she closes the tablet (E-SITE-11, E-SITE-23).
most_useful_feature: No observed feature helps her here: amenities for Havalan (T16) were not observable through text and metadata (E-ACC-05).
missing_information: What Havalan is like, with a date; whether Havalan even has an area page cannot be confirmed from the 81 names observed (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: A dated, area-specific summary in Sorani on each area page.
simulated_reaction: «هیچ بەروارێک نابینم؛ نازانم ئەم زانیارییانە کۆنن یان نوێ.» (I see no date; I cannot tell whether this information is old or new.)

initial_understanding: 'The true value of your property' plus 'Explore Erbil real estate, market indicators and property offers with Andaz.' reads to him as an Erbil property site making two promises at once (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'The latest reviewed source describes it as completed or ready.' on English project pages — reviewed by whom? A low-reading visitor cannot tell what that means (E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: none observed that moved him; the English advisor page 'Let’s find your kind of place.' opens without login, easing his worry about forced registration (E-SITE-18).
frustration_point: His limit is two taps to prices; the project index exists but no price appears in any project description and 10 pages carry one line only (E-SITE-05, E-SITE-22).
most_useful_feature: An English locale with translated project text and a guest-accessible advisor landing (E-SITE-18, E-SITE-20).
missing_information: Azadi price levels; «ئازادی 2» has an area page, but its description is the generic site text with no figures (E-SITE-23, E-SITE-11).
what_would_change_decision: A price figure or range on project and area pages within one tap of the homepage.
simulated_reaction: 'Okay, Erbil property site, got it — but where are the actual prices? Two taps and still nothing.' (Grasps the purpose; leaves because no prices appear quickly.)

initial_understanding: Switching to /ar, the heading «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» matches his seller question exactly, so he reads the site as a valuation tool first (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-20).
main_confusion: 'Welcome back' — the login page stays English for a visitor browsing in Arabic; with basic reading he cannot tell what signing in unlocks (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: Deep scan found only info@andaz.app and info@mulkwallet.com and no phone; a second brand domain puzzles a neutral visitor without stopping him (E-SITE-03).
frustration_point: His trigger is a path ending in an error; /about, /help and /contact land on the bare '404' template with no site chrome in its head (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-18, E-SITE-19).
most_useful_feature: The valuation promise and the page «نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی» exist, pointing at his need to price a duplex (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-16).
missing_information: Recent asking prices in Bahrka; Bahrka is not among the area names observed and /market is a coming-soon page (E-SITE-23, E-SITE-14).
what_would_change_decision: An Arabic login page and a working contact page instead of 404.
simulated_reaction: «صفحة التقييم موجودة، بس صفحة الاتصال تعطي 404 وصفحة الدخول بالإنجليزي.» (The valuation page exists, but contact gives 404 and login is in English.)

initial_understanding: The Arabic description «اكتشف عقارات أربيل ومؤشرات السوق ومعروضات العقارات مع أنداز.» tells him Erbil offers live here, and /ar/offers/map is titled «عقارات للبيع والإيجار — Andaz» (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-20).
main_confusion: 'Welcome back' on /login after browsing in Arabic; he can read it but wonders why the account step changes language (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: Project text names the developer and says 'The latest reviewed source describes it as…', which a trusting renter takes as a sign someone checks data (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-20).
frustration_point: Zero phone numbers across 59 scanned pages; he wants a quick call-back and keeps hunting a contact that metadata never shows (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-08).
most_useful_feature: An area page «بەختیاری» exists among 81 neighbourhoods, so his target area is at least addressable (E-SITE-23).
missing_information: Whether a Bakhtiari house with yard and parking fits $810; listing cards and filters on /offers/map were not observable (E-SITE-07).
what_would_change_decision: A call or WhatsApp route on each offer with a stated response time.
simulated_reaction: «المنطقة موجودة والمشاريع موجودة، بس كيف أتصل بصاحب البيت؟» (The area and projects are there, but how do I call the owner?)

initial_understanding: Reading the Sorani heading «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت», she thinks the site estimates what a house is worth, not a place to compare schools near two projects (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'Create your Andaz account' appears in English from the Kurdish site; she reads it, but it confirms her fear that parts are not in a language she reads comfortably (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: One project named three ways, «شاری ئیتاڵی 2», «شاری ئیتالی 2», «ئیتالی ستی 2», makes a skeptical reader doubt the care behind the data (E-SITE-10).
frustration_point: Her trigger is being sent to another app; nothing like that was observed, so her impatience instead hits the areas index with an empty H1 and nothing to read (E-SITE-06).
most_useful_feature: A page «قەڵای هەولێر» exists among the area pages, matching the Citadel neighbourhood her parents mention (E-SITE-23).
missing_information: Schools, parks and internet near two Citadel-area projects; area pages carry only the generic site description (E-SITE-11, E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: Area pages with amenity lists and a fully Sorani account flow.
simulated_reaction: «ناوی پڕۆژەکە سێ جۆر نووسراوە؛ ئەگەر ناوەکە ڕاست نەبێت، زانیارییەکەی چۆن ڕاست بێت؟» (The project name is written three ways; if the name isn't right, how is the information right?)

initial_understanding: He reads «خانووبەرەکانی هەولێر، نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ و پێشنیارەکان» as three things — properties, indicators, offers — and expects a listings tool for a $90,000 flat (E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: «پرۆژە» and «پڕۆژە» both appear, and «ئەلاسکا تاوەرز» sits beside «ئالاسکا تاور» on one page; a fluent reader wonders which spelling to search for (E-SITE-10).
trust_concern_observed: The advisor landing «با ئەو شوێنە بدۆزینەوە کە بۆ تۆ گونجاوە.» opens without login; whether its answers are honest about installment totals was not observable (E-SITE-13, E-ACC-05).
frustration_point: His trigger is a map that never finishes loading; «نەخشەی نرخەکان» exists, but load behaviour on his small Android was not measured through this route (E-SITE-16, E-ACC-05).
most_useful_feature: Every project page carries GeoCoordinates, so a ready unit near the ring road could be placed on the price map (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-16).
missing_information: Saving a shortlist (T09) and advisor replies (T10) were not observable; no installment total or penalty text exists in project data (E-SITE-08).
what_would_change_decision: Publish installment terms and total cost per project, with a shortlist function usable without login.
simulated_reaction: «ڕاوێژکار هەیە و نەخشە هەیە، بەڵام نازانم کۆی قیستەکان چەندە.» (There is an advisor and a map, but I don't know what the installments add up to.)

initial_understanding: The Arabic homepage promises «اكتشف عقارات أربيل ومؤشرات السوق ومعروضات العقارات مع أنداز.» while its heading talks about his property's value; he settles on 'Erbil property map' (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The Arabic area page shows the Kurdish name «کورانی نوی» instead of an Arabic one, so he is unsure what he would be sharing with the family chat (E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Arabic copy with errors such as «علي شلرع 120 متر» and «تتكون المشروع» makes a skeptical fluent reader doubt who edits the content (E-SITE-10).
frustration_point: A wrong path lands on '404 · Andaz' with only '404' as heading — a dead end for anyone building a shareable link (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-19).
most_useful_feature: Azadi area pages exist («ئازادی 2», «ئازادی ١») with self-canonical URLs per locale, so a link is shareable (E-SITE-23, E-SITE-11).
missing_information: What Azadi offers beyond its name; every area page carries only the generic site description (E-SITE-11, E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: Arabic area names and a short area summary worth sharing.
simulated_reaction: «رابط المنطقة موجود، لكن الاسم بالكردي والوصف عام؛ شو أشارك مع أهلي؟» (The area link exists, but the name is Kurdish and the description generic; what do I share with my family?)

initial_understanding: With basic reading she still picks «خانووبەرەکانی هەولێر» and «پێشنیارەکان» out of the Sorani description: Erbil properties and offers, something she could show the family (E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: 'Create your Andaz account' in English on /register, exactly where she expected Sorani; it feeds her worry that she must register to see anything (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: Nothing changed her neutral view; the advisor page «ڕاوێژکاری خانووبەرەی تۆ — Andaz» opens to guests, which eases the registration worry a little (E-SITE-13).
frustration_point: Her trigger is a map that never finishes; «نەخشەی نرخەکان» exists, but how it loads on her 4G connection was not measured through this route (E-SITE-16, E-ACC-05).
most_useful_feature: 81 area pages named the way residents say them, such as «شۆرش» or «ئیسکان», so a neighbourhood link can be shared (E-SITE-23).
missing_information: Whether Royal City has a project page at all; it is not among the slugs visible in the sitemap excerpt, and 14 project pages hold a line or nothing (E-SITE-02, E-SITE-22).
what_would_change_decision: A Sorani register page and a described page for every project people ask about.
simulated_reaction: «پەڕەی ناوچەکان هەیە و دەتوانم لینک بنێرم، بەڵام ڕۆیاڵ ستی نادۆزمەوە.» (The area pages exist and I can send a link, but I can't find Royal City.)

initial_understanding: She reads the Sorani homepage as a property-value and offers site for Erbil («بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت», «پێشنیارەکان»), which fits her search for a ready flat (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: «نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی» — a page titled 'internal valuation' marked noindex,nofollow; she cannot tell whether it is meant for visitors or for staff (E-SITE-16).
trust_concern_observed: With high privacy concern she looks for a policy; /privacy and /terms return '404 · Andaz', so what the site stores about her stays unanswered (E-SITE-17).
frustration_point: Her trigger is being pushed into another app; none observed, but 4 projects with no description at all, including «ڤیتاڵ», make hunting a ready flat feel pointless (E-SITE-22).
most_useful_feature: Status and developer facts such as «تەواوکراو یان ئامادە» and «فۆر بریجز» on Boulevard let her mentally filter for ready projects (E-SITE-08).
missing_information: Cash price against installment total for a $140,000 unit; no price or payment term in any project data and the rendered page was not observed (E-SITE-08, E-ACC-05).
what_would_change_decision: A privacy page in Sorani and a price basis on every project page.
simulated_reaction: «دۆخی پڕۆژە و گەشەپێدەر دیارە، بەڵام پەڕەی تایبەتمەندی نییە و نرخیش نییە.» (Status and developer are shown, but there is no privacy page and no price.)

initial_understanding: 'Explore Erbil real estate, market indicators and property offers with Andaz.' reads to her as a data platform for professionals, with 'The true value of your property' as the owner hook (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'map.investment' as the /invest page title and heading — a raw translation key where a broker expects an investment map (E-SITE-15).
trust_concern_observed: Structured data is uneven: addressLocality on a minority of project pages, and English project pages canonicalised to the Kurdish URL, which an expert reads as weak data discipline (E-SITE-19, E-SITE-09).
frustration_point: Her trigger is no contact route; 0 phones across the scan and no agent attribution beyond developer names, while /companies reads «کۆمپانیاکانی خانووبەرە بەم زووانە» (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-14).
most_useful_feature: Provenance wording 'The latest reviewed source describes it as…' plus named developers on project pages (E-SITE-20, E-SITE-08).
missing_information: How listings are attributed to agents and whether agent profiles exist; market indicators are a coming-soon page and registration requirements were not observed (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-12).
what_would_change_decision: A companies and agents directory with licence numbers, and a fixed /invest title.
simulated_reaction: 'The provenance line is a good sign, but a page called map.investment and no agent profiles — I cannot pitch this to clients yet.' (Likes the source wording; blocked by the raw key and missing attribution.)

initial_understanding: The Sorani heading «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» plus «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ» in the description make him expect valuation and market numbers he can check before travelling (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە» — the market page announces indicators as coming soon right after the homepage promised them (E-SITE-14).
trust_concern_observed: No legal identity anywhere reachable: /about, /contact and /terms all 404, no social profiles, only info@andaz.app and info@mulkwallet.com found (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-18, E-SITE-03).
frustration_point: His trigger is precisely this absence of a company name or address; a skeptical, impatient visitor meets coming-soon and 404 pages and closes the laptop (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-17).
most_useful_feature: GeoCoordinates on every project page and an area page «ئاشتی 2» let him place candidates before a visit (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-22, E-SITE-11).
missing_information: Who operates the site and who supplied each project; the companies directory is «کۆمپانیاکانی خانووبەرە بەم زووانە» and no company address exists (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-03).
what_would_change_decision: An About page naming the operating company, address and licence, linked from every page.
simulated_reaction: «کۆمپانیا کێیە؟ ناونیشان نییە، تەلەفۆن نییە؛ بە ملیۆن دۆلار متمانە بە پەڕەیەکی بێ ناو ناکەم.» (Who is the company? No address, no phone; I won't trust a nameless page with a million dollars.)

initial_understanding: 'The true value of your property' and a description about offers and indicators arrive together; for a reader who needs one plain idea, the first screen gives two (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'kwrany nwe' — the English area page uses a raw transliteration as the neighbourhood name, unreadable even for someone who lives in Erbil (E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Nothing he would read as dishonest; the English areas index has no heading and a bare 'Andaz' title, which reads as unfinished rather than untrustworthy (E-SITE-06).
frustration_point: His trigger is missing prices; no price exists in any project description and the areas index offers an empty H1, nothing to hold a chance visitor with low patience (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-06).
most_useful_feature: The English offers page is headed 'Properties for sale and rent', a clear label once he reaches it (E-SITE-18).
missing_information: What Havalan or Gazna look like in English; area names are not localised and the areas index has no title or heading to orient him (E-SITE-20, E-SITE-06).
what_would_change_decision: One plain-English purpose line on the first screen and real English area names.
simulated_reaction: 'kwrany nwe? I live in this city and I still don't know what that page is. Closing it.' (The transliterated area name means nothing to him; he leaves.)

initial_understanding: The heading about his property's «بەهای ڕاستەقینە» and the description's «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ» promise exactly the trend comparison he came for (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: 'Welcome back' — after switching to the Kurdish site the login page is English, and with low reading he cannot tell whether trends need an account (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» and named developers raise his trust; /contact, /privacy and /terms returning 404 lower it again for a skeptical visitor (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-17).
frustration_point: His trigger is one unit with two prices; with no prices at all, his real stop is «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە», a placeholder where indicators should be (E-SITE-14).
most_useful_feature: Address data names «نەورۆز» as a locality on some project pages, so Nawroz is at least recognised (E-SITE-19).
missing_information: A dated, sourced price trend for Nawroz against Havalan; /market is coming soon and /invest shows the raw key 'map.investment' (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-15).
what_would_change_decision: Publish dated, sourced area price trends before promising indicators on the homepage.
simulated_reaction: «نیشاندەرەکان بەم زووانە؟ من ئەمڕۆ دەمەوێت بزانم نەورۆز گرانتر بووە یان هاواڵان.» (Indicators coming soon? I want to know today whether Nawroz or Havalan got pricier.)

initial_understanding: She hesitates between «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت», valuing a home she does not own, and «پێشنیارەکان», the offers she wants; the first screen does not settle it (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: «گوندی ( ئینكلیزی)» — a project name with a stray space, bracket and Arabic kaf, and no description; she cannot tell whether the page is finished (E-SITE-22).
trust_concern_observed: No publication or update date anywhere in project metadata, and the legal pages are 404; for a skeptical buyer that is two strikes (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-17).
frustration_point: Her trigger is 'no updated date'; «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» hints at checking but carries no date, so even a patient search ends there (E-SITE-08).
most_useful_feature: Status values like «تەواوکراو یان ئامادە» let her separate ready projects from «لەژێر بنیاتنان» ones (E-SITE-08).
missing_information: A contact route for a ready flat near the stadium: zero phone numbers on all scanned pages and /contact is a 404 (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-17).
what_would_change_decision: A visible 'last updated' date and a phone or WhatsApp on each project.
simulated_reaction: «دەنووسن سەرچاوە پشکنراوە، بەڵام کەی؟ بێ بەروار و بێ ژمارە، چۆن پەیوەندی بکەم؟» (They write the source was checked, but when? Without a date and a number, how do I get in touch?)

initial_understanding: He gets 'Erbil houses and offers' from «خانووبەرەکانی هەولێر» and «پێشنیارەکان», though a heading about his own property's value does not fit someone just passing through (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: 'Create your Andaz account' — the Kurdish-path register page is English; with basic reading in all three languages, the sudden switch is the hardest moment (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: He looks for a 'verified' claim and finds none in metadata; instead «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» names a checked source without saying who checked (E-SITE-08).
frustration_point: His trigger is text that breaks when enlarged; layout was not observed, so his realistic stop is the English account page he cannot comfortably read (E-ACC-05, E-SITE-12).
most_useful_feature: Area pages for «ئازادی 2» and «ئازادی ١» exist and projects carry coordinates, so Azadi is findable (E-SITE-23, E-SITE-22).
